## File: facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/TensorMask/tensormask/arch.py

Prompts

```
['build a TensorMask instance from a detectron2 config to perform instance segmentation with mask prediction', 'build a TensorMaskHead module with classification, box regression, and mask prediction subnets from config', 'run the assignment rule to match ground truth boxes to anchor boxes using containment and centrality rules', 'run TensorMask inference on a batch of images to get detected instances with boxes and masks', 'review the TensorMask losses method to understand focal loss, smooth L1 box regression, and mask BCE loss computation', 'add TensorMask configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode with default anchor, box, mask, and loss parameters', 'review the add_tensormask_config function to understand default TensorMask model configuration parameters', 'summarize the add_tensormask_config function and its default configuration values for TensorMask', 'refactor add_tensormask_config to add new configuration options for the TensorMask model', 'test that add_tensormask_config correctly registers all TensorMask config fields on a CfgNode']
```

Usage

```
{'build_TensorMask_model': 'build a TensorMask instance from a detectron2 config to perform instance segmentation with mask prediction', 'build_TensorMaskHead': 'build a TensorMaskHead module with classification, box regression, and mask prediction subnets from config', 'run_anchor_assignment': 'run the assignment rule to match ground truth boxes to anchor boxes using containment and centrality rules', 'run_TensorMask_inference': 'run TensorMask inference on a batch of images to get detected instances with boxes and masks', 'review_TensorMask_losses': 'review the TensorMask losses method to understand focal loss, smooth L1 box regression, and mask BCE loss computation'}
```
